events.verdict: Suggs (ORL) grazes Mathurin's (IND) shoulder during his shooting motion, but Black (ORL) reaches in and initiates contact to his arm that affects the driving shot attempt. The foul should have been assessed to Black instead of Suggs.
Turner (IND) moves laterally into Wagner (ORL), initiating lower body contact that causes him to trip.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) swipes down and initiates contact with Mathurin's (IND) right arm, which affects his shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Mathurin (IND) extends his leg during his jump shooting motion to create the marginal contact with Caldwell-Pope (ORL).
Siakam (IND) reaches in and Wagner (ORL) lifts his own arm into Siakam's arm, but the contact is marginal.
Haliburton (IND) reaches down towards the ball and makes clean contact with it.
Haliburton (IND) initiates contact across Suggs' (ORL) arm, but the contact is marginal and he moves through the contact to make his intended pass.
Suggs (ORL) places a hand on Haliburton's (IND) back during his shot attempt at the basket and the contact is marginal.
Siakam (IND) makes illegal contact to Suggs' (ORL) arm and body before getting his hand on the ball.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) legally contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Mathurin (IND) and Isaac (ORL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
